● I need one decision before I go on.

─────────────────────────────────────────────
 ☐ Storage

Which storage should the trial task use for
its data?

❯ 1. SQLite file
     One file in the repository. No server
     to run, simple to back up, enough for
     one writer at a time.
  2. Postgres
     A server in Docker. Needed when several
     processes write at the same time or
     when the data is large.
  3. JSON files
     One file for each record. Easy to read
     and to diff, slow for many records and
     without transactions.
  4. In memory only
     Nothing is kept after the process
     ends. Good only for a first test.
  5. Type something.
─────────────────────────────────────────────
  6. Chat about this
